newsitem.title: USA: Court rules against Cheesecake in N. Mexico.
newsitem.headline: Court rules against Cheesecake in N. Mexico.

text.p: Privately-held New Mexico based Cheesecake Factory Inc said a federal court ordered California-based The Cheesecake Factory to stop sales of products in New Mexico under that name.
The court issued a preliminary injunction which remains in effect pending the outcome of a jury trial in the case scheduled to begin September 8 in Albuquerque.
The New Mexico company operates a restaurant in Abuquerque and has sold dessert products in New Mexico since 1973.

The New Mexico company filed a lawsuit on February 13 in federal court in New Mexico against California-based Cheesecake Factory and retailers, Wal-Mart Stores Inc and Price/Costco, alleging trademark and trade name infringement, unfair competition.
